PM.name: Project Management
PM.headline: 10/10 recommended with zero MT/ET and minimal project effort

reviews.quote: PM 10/10 recommended. It was no MT no ET course for us and ironically, PM's project required least effort.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

SMMEI.name: Strategic Management in Media and Entertainment Industry
SMMEI.headline: Typical Term 6 course with movies every class, super chill prof, and easy CP once or twice

reviews.quote:
Course made for 6th term 💯
Movie in every class
Popcorn khao so jao
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: SMMEI:- Super chill course, super chill professor. Just do CP in class once or twice. Take a bid for it if you are interested to know what goes behind strategy for making movies. Typical term 6 course.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

MC.name: Marketing Communications
MC.headline: One of the best professors at IIMB; high effort but high reward

reviews.quote: MarComms by Sam Moorthy - AMAZING course, especially if you're marketing (I wasn't and almost considered switching careers after this course), interesting cases and discussions, great consumer insights, but high effort (Prof. is fun and approachable but he won't give you leeway just because it's term six), personally would recommend despite effort because he's easily one of the best profs we have at IIMB
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: MC lelo bhai. Mehnat lagegi par maza aayega
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: MC is also amazing. One of the best profs in IIMB along with Ramesh Venkatesvarn's PSM i came across
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

GM.name: Global Marketing
GM.headline: Top marketing pick; super fun class with goodies, easy to score very well with regular CP

reviews.quote: GM best
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: Global marketing - Super fun class, lot of goodies. If you do some CP, you’ll deffo score very well
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

BBM.name: Business to Business Marketing
BBM.headline: Excellent teaching style and entertaining cases; high differentiation in CP and project with clear canteen-connect strategy

reviews.quote:
Kuruvila cutie hai ❤️🤏🏼
Professor ki teaching style excellent…. Too good, case padh k aaoge to you will be entertained
Read about him online on Reddit and all. Samajh jaoge
CP and project me bahot jyada differentiate karega. Isme seedha funda hai ki uski najar me raho aur class k bahar mil k apna naam batate raho. He goes to the staff canteen after every class so usko waha chai coffee pine tak escort karo aur beth k baate karo. just show intent and interest. Kaam kuch mat karna chahe project me. Mil jayege marks with a significant edge.
End term was good, 30 marks ka tha shayad and it had 10 ques jisme se 6 attempt krne the probably. Aisa sa pattern tha.

Baki marks aur in sab se matlab nahi to you can sleep peacefully, he will not disturb you ever.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

EAD.name: Exploring Architecture and Design: Lessons for Managers
EAD.headline: Zero BT course with a chill professor, thoroughly enjoyable and fun in-class activities

reviews.quote: Zero BT course
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: EAD - interesting course and chill prof. enjoyed it thoroughly. lot of in class graded activities (fun tho)
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

BSCP.name: Business Strategy and Competition Policy
BSCP.headline: Timepass, no-brainer course with chill prof (occasional temper); very exam-friendly if you avoid silly mistakes

reviews.quote: Ekdum chill course hai, agar prof se ME padha ho toh similar hi padhayenge. MT aur ET me silly mistake nhi karoge toh maje aa jayenge. Learning wise I can't comment because exam ke ek din pehle hi slides khole the.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: Timepass course, chill prof (kabhi kabhi gussa hota hai), no brainer course though
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

EM.name: Entrepreneurial Marketing
EM.headline: Chill professor, easy to score well with regular CP

reviews.quote: 0 learning, cp can be done from chat gpt literally. Prof is very chill, easy to score well if you do cp
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

SPM.name: Software Product Management
SPM.headline: Evening slot, super chill in-class environment and simple exams

reviews.quote: SPM was pretty chill, classes are in the evening and the professor really doesn't care about what you do in class. The content is more useful if you're trying to build a business in the field ig? But the exams are fairly simple. Overall chill course
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: SPM - Super chill course, doesn't matter if you know tech/PM or not, no effort, no restrictions inside the classroom, project you have to do with a company but if you can wing it (PM aspirants, it's not a major value add so don't compromise and take separate days from your friends like I did😭)
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

MCST.name: Managing Career Success & Transition
MCST.headline: In-class group activities with low-pressure participation

reviews.quote:
MCST - good course . Bas sir tumhe har session me group activity karne ko bolenge and phir may ask someone randomly to answer. Nahi answer diya to bhi chalega

Accha timepass hota hai.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

DMS.name: Digital Marketing Strategies
DMS.headline: Excellent professor and must-take for DM enthusiasts, but 10-round simulation is make-or-break

reviews.quote:
Prof is nice, course content is also nice, but there's a simulation which is a course component and that's not nice
It's boring, jab tak aap dimaag chalakar 1 round clear karoge dusre round ka time aa jaayega. And there are 10 rounds. It can potentially be interesting, but only if you really see it through to the end with the same grit
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: DMS - G Shainesh: Excellent professor. Course is also good. Only drawback is it has simulation with 10 rounds — by the time you get to know how it works you are either top of the class or out of the game. Must take if you are really interested in Digital Marketing. You can book Shainesh sir's time if you want to learn more on the particular topic, he is super helpful.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

PBM.name: Platform Business Models
PBM.headline: Heavy workload, strict CP, 40% project; seniors advise avoiding if in placements

reviews.quote:
For those who are reaching out for Platform Business Model (PBM - Thurs slot me 2 lectures):
Placement me Beth rahe ho to avoid hi karna…. Heavy hai course. Har week case padh k Jana, Proff differentiates in CP very much, 40 marks ka heavy project jisme you need to select from some list of projects jo Proff khud dega, you can’t even choose on your own. Bahot sare submissions, project k liye you need to keep on meeting the industry folks and all. Poora bhaang bhosda course hai. Upar se aadhe time EPGP wale log faltu joke maarte rahte hain.
Proff won’t even allow phones and laptops. Sone bhi nahi deta, jaga dega bich bich me.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

DM.name: Decision Making
DM.headline: Seniors strongly advise against taking this course: 'Worst decision to take this course ever!'

reviews.quote: There is nothing good about this course. @~Rushabh Kothari is the right person for this
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

reviews.quote: Worst decision to take this course ever!
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

CBM.name: Commercial Bank Management
CBM.headline: Strict professor, undisclosed grading, rigid classroom rules — only for CAs/banking background

reviews.quote: CBM professor - Orthodox male in his 60s. Is course me sirf 25 log the last year and I couldn’t drop because of the min students rule. If you are a CA or someone with banking experience to theek h le lo warna leave it. He doesn’t upload the slides on time, ajeeb se questions in the quizzes, very weird marking schemes, didn’t disclose the marks and grades out kar di. Class me phone nahi chalane deta, baat nahi karne deta. Bacho bhai bacho
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

WS_11.name: Marcomms at Work
WS_11.headline: Workshop taught by Sam Moorthy — highly praised marketing faculty

reviews.quote: MarComms by Sam Moorthy - AMAZING course, especially if you're marketing. Interesting cases and discussions, great consumer insights, easily one of the best profs we have at IIMB.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

TSFT.name: Time Series and Forecasting Techniques
TSFT.headline: Seniors advise against taking this in the final term: 'Why do you want to see Soudeep Deb in last sem?'

reviews.quote:
Why do you want to see Soudeep Deb in last sem?
Eliminated with a one liner 😅
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

GCK.name: General Commercial Knowledge
GCK.headline: Chill prof who lets you sleep/use phone, but terminology-heavy and exams have super random questions

reviews.quote: Good course, chill prof. Lets you sleep/use phone in the class, no worries. Technical-knowledge heavy in terms of keywords/terminology etc. Mid and end terms can be super random because he makes absolutely stupid questions.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

IHP.name: Introduction to Hindu Philosophy
IHP.headline: Zero ongoing workload with only exams at the end; professor expects sincere, thoughtful answers

reviews.quote: No workload, it’s just exams in the end. Previous batches got some assignments, but we didn’t get any. Haan bohot ghatiya answers likhe tho usko pasand nahi aatha (dislikes poor answers, otherwise very chill).
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

IWR.name: Introduction to World Religions
IWR.headline: Zero ongoing workload with only exams at the end; evaluated on depth and quality of answers

reviews.quote: No workload, it’s just exams in the end. Previous batches got some assignments, but we didn’t get any. Haan bohot ghatiya answers likhe tho usko pasand nahi aatha.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior

SL.name: Strategic Leadership
SL.headline: Competitive for top grades due to 30% CP, but super chill if relaxed about marks with low-effort project and mid-term

reviews.quote:
SL course load is high if you decide to get marks - CP is 30% and people are also typically competitive. Really chill if you don't read cases though. Project was also chill, ek ya do raat ka effort maara tha shayad. MT also chill.

My SL and my grade in SL both were super chill.
reviews.author: IIMB Senior
